findings.reason: Forget removes the key from the Group's map. The existing function continues, and a later call can start a new execution.
The old call's deferred cleanup compares its own call pointer with the current map entry. If a new call is registered under the key, its distinct pointer prevents the old cleanup from deleting it.

While the original call is registered, the duplicate attaches its channel and returns before launching its function. A normal return delivers the original value and error to each attached channel. Panic and Goexit bypass result delivery.
Completion removes the call if it still owns the map entry. A later call with no registered entry starts a new execution.

findings.reason: Duplicate suppression is scoped to the receiving Group. Independently initialized Groups look up the same key in separate maps.
The component clears the completed entry if it still owns the key, including when the function returns an error. Its contract leaves application caching and request admission policy open.
